doc.title: Marty Morell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017

title: Supportive parents and studying at Manhattan School and Juilliard
summary: His Puerto Rican mother loved music; his father urged an education.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Were your parents supportive of this path?

Yeah, yeah they were. My dad and my mom — she’s Puerto Rican. She used to sing in Puerto Rico as a young girl and actually she loved music. And my dad, see my dad was a businessman and he said, “Look, okay. You want to be a musician that’s great. But get an education.” And I said, “Okay. That sounds good.” So then I followed that path and I went to Manhattan School of Music and I studied at Juilliard, percussion at Juilliard, and that served me well. And it was nice that they were behind what I wanted to do. © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
